claim.logical_use: each certificate excludes its target from swallowing a source bridge, because cut rank would force both selected 2x2 block minors, and hence their signed combination, to vanish
claim.result: none of the twelve one-active wrong-split target directions can satisfy the source-bridge rank-one character-block equations at a strict K3P point

domain.certificate_domain: every edge Fourier spectrum and inheritance parameter is in (0,1)
domain.k3p_principal_domain_implication: D3,+ is a subset of the certified open edge-spectrum cube
domain.strictness: after a strictly positive monomial factor, every tensor Bernstein coefficient is nonnegative and at least one is positive; every Bernstein basis function is positive in the open cube
